items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: my brother was with another show called McCabe's Troubadours in Kansas, and he sent for me again

ctx.x: What was the name of the theater?

Pastime. On Second Avenue...Second Street in Muskogee, and we ran it for quite awhile. Then my brother went back East again, and I went to Muskogee, I mean to Tulsa and managed a theater there for a fellow for three or four months, and that's where I worked Jelly Roll Morton come through there, and he came by through there, and we got acquainted, and we got...kind of, you know ...close together. I liked his kind of style of (those)... music in those days, and I didn't know that I was ever going to be anything…
